en.title: Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat as Alaska race remains uncalled
en.dek: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi's Senate race while vote counting continues in Alaska.
facts: Democrat Scott Colom defeated incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi's U.S. Senate race.
Colom is the first Black senator elected from Mississippi since the 19th century.
The Alaska Senate race between Mary Peltola and Dan Sullivan remains undecided as ballots continue to be counted.
A court rejected the Peltola campaign's request to include rejected absentee ballots in the final tally.
A poll shows JD Vance and Marco Rubio leading early preferences for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination.
California Governor Gavin Newsom said he does not expect Democrats to change course on clean energy following the midterms.
body: Democrat Scott Colom has won the U.S. Senate race in Mississippi, defeating incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith. According to NPR and CNBC, Colom is the first Black senator elected from the state since the 19th century.

The Senate race between former Representative Mary Peltola and Senator Dan Sullivan remains undecided as ballots continue to be counted. According to The Hill and Fox News, Peltola maintains a narrow lead while Sullivan has gained ground following recent vote tallies.
Fox News reported that a court ruled against the Peltola campaign regarding rejected absentee ballots, denying the campaign's request to include those specific rejected ballots in the final tally.

The Hill and The Jerusalem Post reported that a poll shows Vice President JD Vance and Senator Marco Rubio are favored for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination. Neither Vance nor Rubio has formally launched a campaign, and the nominating contests remain more than a year away.

California Governor Gavin Newsom said at COP31 that he doesn't expect Democrats to do anything but double down on clean energy following the midterms, according to Semafor. Newsom cautioned against romanticizing what this will mean.
The New York Times reported on latest Senate polls from the 2026 midterm elections.
The Alaska Senate race outcome will determine which party holds the seat in the upper chamber.
Legal challenges surrounding the Alaska contest have been resolved with the court's decision on absentee ballots.
The Mississippi Senate race result changes party representation for one of the state's two Senate seats.
en.context: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections determined the composition of the Senate, with formal nominating contests for the 2028 presidential election cycle beginning more than a year away.

de.dek: Der Demokrat Scott Colom besiegte die Amtsinhaberin Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi, während das Senatsrennen in Alaska zwischen Mary Peltola und Dan Sullivan andauert.
body: Der Demokrat Scott Colom gewann am 12. November die US-Senatswahl in Mississippi. Laut NPR und CNBC besiegte er die republikanische Amtsinhaberin Cindy Hyde-Smith.

Colom ist der erste schwarze Senator, der seit dem 19. Jahrhundert in Mississippi gewählt wurde, wie NPR und CNBC berichteten. Dieses Ergebnis markiert einen Wechsel in der Senatsvertretung des Bundesstaates.

Wahlbeamte in Alaska zählen weiterhin die Stimmzettel im Rennen zwischen der ehemaligen Abgeordneten Mary Peltola und Senator Dan Sullivan. The Hill und Fox News berichteten, dass das Rennen zum 12. November noch nicht entschieden ist.
Peltola hält laut The Hill und Fox News einen knappen Vorsprung bei der Stimmenauszählung. Sullivan konnte nach jüngsten Stimmenzuwächsen im Bundesstaat Boden gutmachen.

Das Peltola-Wahlkampfteam verlor kürzlich einen Gerichtsprozess bezüglich abgelehnter Briefwahlunterlagen. Fox News gab an, dass das Gericht den Versuch des Wahlkampfteams, diese Stimmzettel in die endgültige Auszählung einzubeziehen, zurückwies.
Wahlbeamte in Alaska verarbeiten die verbleibenden Stimmzettel, um den Sieger zu ermitteln. Sowohl The Hill als auch Fox News merkten an, dass das Ergebnis von der endgültigen Auszählung abhängt.
facts: Scott Colom besiegte die republikanische Amtsinhaberin Cindy Hyde-Smith bei der US-Senatswahl in Mississippi.
Colom ist der erste schwarze Senator, der seit dem 19. Jahrhundert in Mississippi gewählt wurde.
Das Senatsrennen in Alaska zwischen Mary Peltola und Dan Sullivan ist weiterhin unentschieden.
Peltola führt in Alaska knapp, während die Auszählung der Stimmzettel andauert.
Ein Gericht wies eine Klage des Peltola-Wahlkampfteams bezüglich der Briefwahlunterlagen ab.

Colom is the first Black senator elected from Mississippi since the 19th century, as reported by NPR and CNBC. This result marks a change in the state's Senate representation.

Alaska election officials continue to count ballots in the race between former Representative Mary Peltola and Senator Dan Sullivan. The Hill and Fox News reported that the race remains uncalled as of 12 November.
Peltola maintains a narrow lead in the vote count, according to The Hill and Fox News. Sullivan has gained ground following recent vote drops in the state.

Election officials in Alaska are processing the remaining ballots to determine the winner. Both The Hill and Fox News noted that the outcome depends on the final count.

en.headline: Trump credits Colom's Mississippi Senate win over Republican voters
en.body: President Trump stated he gives Scott Colom a lot of credit for his upset victory. Trump said he does not know Colom personally but acknowledges his efforts to win over Republican voters.

de.headline: Trump dankt Colom für Senats-Sieg in Mississippi
de.body: Präsident Trump gibt Scott Colom viel Credit für seinen überraschenden Sieg. Trump sagte, er kenne Colom persönlich nicht, anerkenne aber seine Anstrengungen, republikanische Wähler zu gewinnen.

es.headline: Trump atribuye la victoria de Colom al Senado de Mississippi a los votantes republicanos
es.body: El presidente Trump afirmó que le da mucho crédito a Scott Colom por su victoria sorpresa. Trump dijo que no conoce personalmente a Colom pero reconoce sus esfuerzos por ganarse a los votantes republicanos.

pt.headline: Trump reconhece mérito a Colom pela vitória no Senado do Mississippi junto dos eleitores republicanos
pt.body: O Presidente Trump afirmou que reconhece muito mérito a Scott Colom pela sua vitória surpreendente. Trump disse que não conhece Colom pessoalmente, mas reconhece os seus esforços para conquistar os eleitores republicanos.

ja.headline: トランプ氏、コロム氏のミシシッピ州上院選勝利を共和党支持層へのアピールと評価
ja.body: トランプ大統領は、スコット・コロム氏の波乱の勝利に対し、多大な評価を与えていると述べた。トランプ氏はコロム氏と個人的な知り合いではないとしつつも、共和党支持層の獲得に向けた彼の努力を認めた。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 콜롬의 미시시피 상원 승리 공로를 공화당 유권자들에게 돌리다
ko.body: 트럼프 대통령은 스콧 콜롬의 이변 승리에 대해 그에게 많은 공을 돌린다고 밝혔다. 트럼프는 콜롬을 개인적으로 알지는 못하지만, 공화당 유권자들을 설득하려는 그의 노력은 인정한다고 말했다.

it.headline: Trump riconosce a Colom il merito di aver conquistato gli elettori repubblicani in Mississippi
it.body: Il presidente Trump ha dichiarato di attribuire a Scott Colom un grande merito per la sua vittoria a sorpresa. Trump ha detto di non conoscere personalmente Colom, ma di riconoscerne gli sforzi per conquistare gli elettori repubblicani.

fr.headline: Trump attribue la victoire de Colom au Sénat du Mississippi à sa capacité à convaincre les électeurs républicains
fr.body: Le président Trump a déclaré accorder beaucoup de crédit à Scott Colom pour sa victoire surprise. Trump a précisé ne pas connaître personnellement Colom, mais a reconnu ses efforts pour séduire les électeurs républicains.

zh.headline: 特朗普将斯科特·科洛姆在密西西比州参议院选举中的胜选归功于其争取共和党选民的努力
zh.body: 特朗普总统表示，他非常认可斯科特·科洛姆（Scott Colom）此次爆冷胜选的表现。特朗普称他并不认识科洛姆本人，但承认其在争取共和党选民方面所付出的努力。

en.headline: Trump says Gulf allies urged restraint on Iran acknowledging war political cost
en.body: In an interview, Trump stated Gulf allies had urged him to delay further strikes on Iran. Trump acknowledged the war had hurt Republicans in the midterms.

de.headline: Trump sagt Golf-Staaten Zurückhaltung bei Iran wegen politischer Kosten des Krieges
de.body: In einem Interview sagte Trump, Golf-Staaten hätten ihn gebeten, weitere Angriffe auf Iran zu verschieben. Trump erkannte an, dass der Krieg den Republikanern bei den Zwischenwahlen geschadet habe.

es.headline: Trump afirma que aliados del Golfo le instaron a contenerse en Irán reconociendo el coste político de la guerra
es.body: En una entrevista, Trump afirmó que los aliados del Golfo le instaron a retrasar nuevos ataques contra Irán. Trump reconoció que la guerra había perjudicado a los republicanos en las elecciones de mitad de mandato.

pt.headline: Trump diz que aliados do Golfo pediram contenção sobre o Irão e reconhece custo político da guerra
pt.body: Numa entrevista, Trump afirmou que aliados do Golfo o tinham instado a adiar mais ataques ao Irão. Trump reconheceu que a guerra prejudicou os republicanos nas eleições de meio de mandato.

ja.headline: トランプ氏、湾岸諸国同盟がイランへのさらなる攻撃の自制を促したと発言、戦争の政治的コストを認識
ja.body: インタビューでトランプ氏は、湾岸諸国同盟がイランへのさらなる攻撃を遅らせるよう彼に促したと述べた。トランプ氏は、戦争が中間選挙で共和党に打撃を与えたことを認めた。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 걸프 동맹국들이 이란에 대한 추가 공격 자제 촉구하며 전쟁의 정치적 비용 인정
ko.body: 트럼프는 인터뷰에서 걸프 동맹국들이 이란에 대한 추가 공격을 미루도록 촉구했다고 밝혔다. 트럼프는 전쟁이 중간선거에서 공화당에 피해를 주었음을 인정했다.

it.headline: Trump: gli alleati del Golfo hanno chiesto moderazione sull'Iran, consapevoli del costo politico della guerra
it.body: In un'intervista, Trump ha affermato che gli alleati del Golfo gli avevano chiesto di ritardare ulteriori attacchi contro l'Iran. Trump ha riconosciuto che la guerra ha danneggiato i repubblicani nelle elezioni di metà mandato.

fr.headline: Trump affirme que ses alliés du Golfe ont prôné la retenue face à l'Iran, conscient du coût politique d'une guerre
fr.body: Dans une interview, Trump a déclaré que ses alliés du Golfe l'avaient incité à retarder de nouvelles frappes contre l'Iran. Trump a reconnu que la guerre avait nui aux républicains lors des élections de mi-mandat.

zh.headline: 特朗普称海湾盟友敦促其对伊朗保持克制，并承认战争带来的政治代价
zh.body: 在一次采访中，特朗普表示海湾盟友曾敦促他推迟对伊朗采取进一步打击行动。特朗普承认，战争已对共和党的中期选举选情造成了损害。
